text:
Entry into Israel a day before visa expiry.
Hi all, 

I'm on a B1 partner visa with my Israeli partner. We are flying to India to spend Diwali (the most important hindu holiday) with my family. The holiday is on the 8th of November. And we fly back together on the 9th, via Abu Dhabi. My visa expires on the 10th and the misrad hapanim in rehovot gave us an interview date for the 12th. The lady at the MH office said it's ok for me to enter a day before but I'm concerned if the airport authorities in India and Abu Dhabi will allow me to travel. Does anyone have any experience? 

Thank you 🤍
